description: DAG-based multi-agent orchestration engine where agents reason autonomously, invoke tools, and complete tasks in parallel. Built OrchestratorService with Redis pub/sub to trigger downstream agents in real time, and AgentConsumer via Bull Queue with OpenAI tool-calling loops. Features a 3-table PostgreSQL schema with Redis Sets for distributed completion tracking, plus an SSE module and React Flow frontend to visualise DAG execution live as agents complete.

I wanted to reuse context across AI chats instead of re-explaining every time. So I built a small RAG system: store past conversations, embed them, and when you start a new chat you can pull in the relevant bits. Chrome extension captures messages, NestJS + Qdrant + Bull handle the backend, and I used OpenAI to summarize chunks before injection so it stays readable.

Started as a weekend thing and got a bit out of hand. Live HN feed, filters, sorting — and I hooked in the OpenAI API to generate short summaries so you could skim without opening every link. React + Express + Socket.IO for the real-time bit. Good fun.
